The 2026 LIV Golf League campaign finished a week early at The Club at Chatham Hills, following the cancellation of the Team Championship, with Michael La Sasso claiming his breakthrough professional victory and Jon Rahm's Legion XIII securing the team title. LIV chief executive Scott O'Neil told reporters on Wednesday he was optimistic about their reimagined plans for 2027, despite the loss of financial backing from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), with players set to be equity owners and have their commercial rights restored. messages.text: Nev: Wirtz and Isak Liverpool's biggest disappointments - they must improve

metadata.summary: Gary Neville called on Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak to improve after a year of "being kind to" Liverpool's £200m+ duo, but said he had faith the pair would come good despite being their "biggest disappointments" at Newcastle.

Neville says the pair are 'too nice' and wants to see Wirtz have a much greater influence in the final third. Gary Neville called on Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak to improve after a year of "being kind to" Liverpool's £200m+ duo, but said he had faith the pair would come good despite being their "biggest disappointments" at Newcastle. Isak played the entire 90 minutes on his first return to St James' Park since becoming the Premier League's most expensive player last summer, though offered little more than Wirtz who was substituted just after the hour mark for Alexis Mac Allister.
